extracted.intended_audience: authors and developers of systematic reviews and reporting guideline developers (researchers, journal editors, review teams)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and extensions to the PRISMA 2020 reporting statement covering reporting standards for different types of systematic reviews, data sources, and review questions; includes lists of published and in-development extensions and instructions for proposing new extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extensions (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Several official extensions to PRISMA have been developed to cover aspects of reporting not captured in the main PRISMA statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These extensions provide reporting guidance for reviews that, for example, address particular review questions (e.g. diagnostic test accuracy), or use particular data sources (e.g. individual participant data). Click on the relevant extension for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: SWiM (Synthesis Without Meta-analysis)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides reporting guidance for systematic reviews of interventions in which alternative synthesis methods to meta-analysis of effect estimates are used.

rubrics_metrics.name: TIDieR-SRs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides guidance on intervention reporting in systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process for developing a new PRISMA extension
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are interested in developing a new PRISMA 2020 extension, please complete the application form and email it to prismastatement@gmail.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The PRISMA Executive will consider your proposal against the criteria for approving new PRISMA extensions at their monthly meeting. (Application form link provided on the page.)
